claims.title: Orchestration
claims.claim: Creator intent becomes a versioned task graph with explicit dependencies.

claims.title: Structured execution
claims.claim: Task states separate execution, verification, certification, failure and human review.

claims.title: Validation
claims.claim: World 1 recorded 11 of 11 whole-world quality gates passing.

claims.title: Evidence
claims.claim: Production V1 records append-only, hash-chained events and binds certification to artifacts and provenance.

claims.title: Repair
claims.claim: Ambiguous outcomes require reconciliation; retry requires proven non-mutation and valid approval.

claims.title: Persistence
claims.claim: World 1 restart certification recorded zero semantic differences and 167 passing focused tests.

claims.title: Governance
claims.claim: Scoped approval gates exist; World 5 is technically complete and stopped for Game Director review.

claims.title: Provider neutrality
claims.claim: Department request/result contracts and policy-compatible routing are provider-neutral; universal provider interoperability is not claimed.

claims.title: World 5 inventory
claims.claim: World 5 recorded 600 loaded actors, four buildings, 40 trees and 24 dressing elements.

claims.title: World 5 verification
claims.claim: World 5 review records save/reload and independent cold restart passing, with 586 tests and 11 controlled negative tests passing.

claims.title: Production end-to-end fixture
claims.claim: Production V1 recorded four tasks, 26 committed events, three certifications and separate-process reopen.
